BABSB.Title: Import Statblock
BABSB.FileHint: Choose a file (.txt, .md, .pdf, or an image), drop one onto this window, or paste a screenshot into the box below. Or just paste text. PDF and image reading download their libraries on first use.
BABSB.Placeholder: Paste a statblock here (name, size/type, AC, HP, abilities, actions…)
BABSB.Unsupported: {name}: unsupported file type. Use .txt, .md, .pdf or an image.
BABSB.ReadOk: Loaded {name}. Check the text, then Import.
BABSB.ReadOcr: Read {lines} lines by OCR ({dropped} noise lines dropped). OCR can misread names and numbers: check the text below, fix anything wrong, then Import.
BABSB.WarnBody: These values did not add up. Review them before using the actor:
BABSB.BadOptions: Tesseract options setting is not valid JSON: {error}
BABSB.Setting.pdfJsUrl.Name: pdf.js URL
BABSB.Setting.pdfJsUrl.Hint: ES module build of pdf.js, loaded on first PDF upload.
BABSB.Setting.pdfWorkerUrl.Name: pdf.js worker URL
BABSB.Setting.tesseractUrl.Name: Tesseract.js URL
BABSB.Setting.tesseractUrl.Hint: Browser build of Tesseract.js, loaded on first image upload.
BABSB.Setting.tesseractLangUrl.Name: OCR language data URL
BABSB.Setting.tesseractLangUrl.Hint: Folder containing eng.traineddata.gz. Leave blank to use Tesseract's default.
BABSB.Setting.tesseractOptions.Name: Advanced: Tesseract worker options (JSON)
BABSB.Setting.tesseractOptions.Hint: Optional. To run fully offline, self-host the files and set e.g. {"workerPath":"/modules/x/worker.min.js","corePath":"/modules/x/core","langPath":"/modules/x/lang"}.
